Solana "nearly outage" and Why That Proves @Solana is The Blockchain for Wall Street: Yesterday, one of Solana's infrastructure provider Terraswitch went outage, and the network "nearly went down". That's all the haters know. But here are the facts they decline to know: 👉from @jacobvcreech: - 597 of 699 staked validators kept voting - Affected validators recovered within 40 minutes - Validators in the Solana Foundation Delegation Program (SFDP) were unaffected 👉from @trentdotsol: - Devnet did halt actually, then immediately resumed without intervention where the issues are solved. 👉from @toly: - Alpenglow can survive to 40% down (So, not 33.34% as what most people know). So, how we should see this incident, quoted from Toly: "It wouldn’t have been a halt, it would have stopped confirming blocks until the partition repaired itself." We would see this incident as a positive sign for Solana network. Let's look at other numbers to see why: 1. The total SOL staked has never stop climbing since the start of this year. 2. The network keeps increase its decentralization: Top-3 ASN concentration has fallen substantially, from roughly 50–55% → 41%. None of the validators account for more than 4% of SOL staked. 3. Solana remains the fastest blockchain, with 1,909 real-time TPS 4. Solana reached its new ATH in monthly transactions, ~4.2B transactions/month. A network that is: fast, cheap, and reliable - what enterprise does not need it? #Solana #SOL

That's all the haters know. But here are the facts they decline to know: 👉from @jacobvcreech: - 597 of 699 staked validators kept voting - Affected validators recovered within 40 minutes - Validators in the Solana Foundation Delegation Program (SFDP) were unaffected 👉from @trentdotsol: - Devnet did halt actually, then immediately resumed without intervention where the issues are solved. 👉from @toly: - Alpenglow can survive to 40% down (So, not 33.34% as what most people know). So, how we should see this incident, quoted from Toly: "It wouldn’t have been a halt, it would have stopped confirming blocks until the partition repaired itself." We would see this incident as a positive sign for Solana network. Let's look at other numbers to see why: 1. The total SOL staked has never stop climbing since the start of this year. 2. The network keeps increase its decentralization: Top-3 ASN concentration has fallen substantially, from roughly 50–55% → 41%. None of the validators account for more than 4% of SOL staked. 3. Solana remains the fastest blockchain, with 1,909 real-time TPS 4. Solana reached its new ATH in monthly transactions, ~4.2B transactions/month. A network that is: fast, cheap, and reliable - what enterprise does not need it? #Solana #SOL
